213 EAST FOOTHILL BOULEVARD 7:30 P.M. REGULAR MEETING
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
* Call to Order
7:30 P.M. REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR REGULAR MEETING
Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the Agenda are on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection at the City Library.
Persons who wish to speak during the Public Participation portion of the Agenda, shall fill out a card requesting to speak and shall submit it to the City Clerk prior to the start of the City Council meeting. When called, each person may address any item on or off the agenda during the public participation.
In compliance with Government Code Section 54957.5 staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the Agenda ,are available for inspection by members of the public in the Office of the City Clerk, City Library, Police Department Lobby and City of Azusa Web Page.
B.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
This time has been set aside for persons in the audience to make public comments on items within the subject matter jurisdiction of the council/agency board that are not listed on this agenda or are listed on this agenda as an item other than a public hearing item. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address the city council/agency board about public hearing items at the time the public hearing is held. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the council/agency board is prohibited from taking action on oral requests, but may refer the matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting. The council/agency board will respond after public comment has been received. Each person or representative of a group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to five (5) continuous minutes, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes.
C.
REPORTS, UPDATES, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM STAFF/COUNCIL
1.
Selection of Council for city representation at the various outside Agency Board and Committees April 2013 to March 2015.
C-1 Appointmet Boards and Committees
C-1 Attachments Committee Assignment 2011-2013
2.
Request to designate voting delegate and alternate to the Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) General Assembly to be held May 2-3, 2013 in Palm Desert.
3.
Mayor Rocha: a request for $150.00 sponsorship for 15 Azusa students for a fieldtrip to the National History Museum on Tuesday, April 2.
4.
Councilmember Gonzales: Request for certificates in recognition to the students who helped their school build strategies to improve lines of communication. To be presented April 11, at the Human Relations Commission meeting.
D.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
SPECIAL ELECTION VOTING FOR A SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY (WQA) BOARD ALTERNATE REPRESENTING CITIES WITH PRESCRIPTIVE WATER PUMPING RIGHTS.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution No. 13-C14 casting its votes for City of Azusa Councilman Robert Gonzales to the position of alternate board member to the WQA Board representing cities with prescriptive water pumping rights.
D-1 Council Agenda Scheduled Item WQA Alternate Voting
D-1 WQA Election Board Resolution
D-1 WQA Letter Requesting Alternate Board Member Voting
D-1 WQA Election Azusa Ballot Votes to be Cast
D-1 WQA Election of Alternate Candidates
D-1 WQA Election of Board-Cities with Pumping Rights
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 4, 2013.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes as written.
E-1 March 4, 2013, City Minutes
2.
WARRANTS. RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING PAYMENT OF WARRANTS BY THE CITY.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution No. 13-C15 allowing certain claims and demands and specifying the fund out of which the same are to be paid.
E-2 Warrant Resolution City
3.
HUMAN RESOURCES ACTION ITEMS.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Personnel Action Requests in accordance with the City of Azusa Civil Service Rules and applicable Memorandum of Understanding(s).
E-3 H.R. Action Item
4.
CITY TREASURER'S REPORT AS OF FEBURARY 2013.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive, review, and file the City Treasurer's Report for the City of Azusa for the month of February, 2013.
E-4 Treasurers Report, February 2013
E-4 Treasurer Report, Bank Accounts
E-4 Treasurer Report, City CD
E-4 Treasurer Report, City Agencies
E-4 Treasurer Report, L&W CD
E-4 Treasurer Report, L&W Agencies
5.
HELICOPTER SERVICE CONTRACT EXTENSION.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve a one year, Helicopter service contract extension with the City of El Monte.
E-5 Agenda Item El Monte Helicopter Service
E-5 Attachment El Monte - Azusa Helicopter First Amend
6.
ACCEPTANCE OF IMPROVEMENTS FOR THE ELS OUTLET AT 880 SOUTH AZUSA AVENUE. RECOMMENDATION:
Accept the improvements required for the ELS Outlet project at 880 South Azusa Avenue as complete and release the improvement bonds.
E-6 Agenda Report - ELS Outlet Improvements
E-6 Attachment - ELS Bond Release Request
7.
GOLD LINE LIGHT RAIL STATIONS NAMING RECOMMENDATIONS. RECOMMENDATION:
Authorize staff to submit the proposed station names "Azusa - Civic Center" and "Azusa - University Station" to the METRO Board.
E-7 Agenda Report - Gold Line Station Naming
E-7 Attachment-METRO Station Naming Policy
E-7 - Attachment - METRO Station Names
F.
CLOSED SESSION
NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION
Prior to going into closed session the City Council will convene in the Auditorium serving as council chambers to take public comment on the closed session items only. General public comment will be provided for during the regular portion of the meeting beginning at 7:30 P.M.
1.
CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR - Gov. Code Sec. 54957.6. City Negotiator: City Manager James Makshanoff
Organizations: SEIU (Service Employees International Union)
2.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - EXISTING LITIGATION - Gov. Code Sec. 54956.9 (a). City of Duarte vs. City of Azusa, Los Angeles Superior Court, Case No. Case No. BS127709.
G.
ADJOURNMENT
1.
